checkedAlternates.risk: Tabernas in Spain is sometimes assumed to be North African.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Tabernas Desert in Almería, Spain is Europe’s only true desert (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: The Arabian Desert borders the Red Sea opposite the Sahara.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The Arabian Peninsula is part of West Asia (group-4), not Africa (group-3).
